# Interaction Design Foundation (IxDF)

> > The Interaction Design Foundation (IxDF) offers UX design courses, master classes, and educational resources covering user research, service design, accessibility, and design leadership.

IxDF provides professional UX education through courses taught by industry experts like William Hudson, Frank Spillers, and Jeff Johnson. The platform covers foundational topics like personas and user research, advanced subjects like design systems and UX management, and emerging areas like AI-generated imagery and inclusive design.

## Key Topics

- User Research
- Personas
- Service Design
- UX Management
- Accessibility & Universal Design
- Inclusive Design
- Design Systems & Design Tokens
- UX Writing
- Human-Centered Design
- User-Centered Design
- Presentation Skills
- Cross-Cultural Design
- Gamification & Storytelling
- AI Image Generation
- UX Maturity

## Core Courses

- [Personas and User Research: Design Products and Services People Need and Want](https://ixdf.org/courses/personas-user-research-design-products-people-need): Beginner course on personas & user research by William Hudson (Syntagm)
- [UX Management: Strategy and Tactics](https://ixdf.org/courses/ux-management-strategy-and-tactics): Intermediate course on UX leadership by Frank Spillers (Experience Dynamics)
- [Service Design: How to Design Integrated Service Experiences](https://ixdf.org/courses/service-design-how-to-design-integrated-service-experiences): Intermediate service design course covering blueprints & journey mapping

## Master Classes

- [How to Design with the Mind in Mind](https://ixdf.org/master-classes/how-to-design-with-the-mind-in-mind): Psychology-driven UX design master class with Jeff Johnson
- [Design Tokens: Powering Your Design System](https://ixdf.org/master-classes/design-tokens-powering-your-design-system): Design tokens & systems master class by Henry Daggett (Societe Generale)
- [UX Writing: How to Use Words as a Design Power Tool](https://ixdf.org/master-classes/ux-writing-how-to-use-words-as-a-design-power-tool): UX writing master class with Torrey Podmajersky (Google, OfferUp)
- [How to Use User Research to Design the Best Products and Services](https://ixdf.org/master-classes/how-to-use-user-research-to-design-the-best-products-and-services): User research master class with Susan & Guthrie Weinschenk
- [How to Create AI Images: On-Brand and Inclusive Photography](https://ixdf.org/master-classes/how-to-create-ai-images-on-brand-and-inclusive-photography): AI image generation master class with Pablo Stanley (Musho, Lummi)
- [Evaluating Your UX Maturity: Limits and Opportunities](https://ixdf.org/master-classes/evaluating-your-ux-maturity-limits-and-opportunities): UX maturity assessment master class by Frank Spillers

## Essential Guides & Documentation

- [How to Create Research-Backed User Personas: The UX Designer's 2025 Guide](https://ixdf.org/literature/article/user-persona-guide): 2025 guide to research-backed personas by William Hudson & Alan Cooper
- [Top UX and UI Design Tools for 2026: A Comprehensive Guide](https://ixdf.org/literature/article/ux-design-tools-definitive-guide): Comprehensive 2026 guide to UX/UI design tools & software
- [How to Screen Research Participants](https://ixdf.org/literature/article/how-to-screen-research-participants): Guide to participant screening & recruitment by William Hudson
- [Learn to Create Accessible Websites with the Principles of Universal Design](https://ixdf.org/literature/article/learn-to-create-accessible-websites-with-the-principles-of-universal-design): Universal design principles for web accessibility by Ruby Zheng
- [MatchDog Build Your Portfolio Project: Grids and Grammar](https://ixdf.org/literature/article/matchdog-build-your-portfolio-project-grids-and-grammar): Portfolio project guide: grid systems & IA for mobile app design

## Design Leadership & Presentation Skills

- [How to Present Like Steve Jobs (Without the Turtleneck)](https://ixdf.org/literature/article/how-to-present-like-steve-jobs-without-the-turtleneck): Master Steve Jobs' presentation style: clarity, empathy & storytelling
- [Present Like a Pro: Become a Designer Who Leads](https://ixdf.org/literature/article/present-like-a-pro): Presentation skills for design leadership & stakeholder management

## Inclusive & Cross-Cultural Design

- [3 Reasons Why Accessible Design Is Good for All](https://ixdf.org/literature/article/3-reasons-why-accessible-design-is-good-for-all): Accessibility benefits & curb-cut effect for universal design
- [Design for Other Cultures](https://ixdf.org/literature/article/design-for-other-cultures): Cross-cultural design: localization, internationalization & globalization

## Optional

- [The Use of Story and Emotions in Gamification](https://ixdf.org/literature/article/the-use-of-story-and-emotions-in-gamification): Storytelling & emotional design in gamification for user engagement
- [How to Capture Your Ideas Before They Disappear](https://ixdf.org/literature/article/how-to-capture-your-ideas-before-they-disappear): Ideation techniques & creative workflow for capturing design ideas
